verdict.rationale: Qodo applies work at scale through automation and inherited configuration rather than user-triggered bulk actions. It automatically reviews every pull request, organization-level settings and `.pr_agent.toml` apply across all connected repositories, and governance enforces standards across every repository. However, finding actions (discuss, dismiss, apply fix) and MCP/CLI resolution are documented only per item. missing for 10: explicit bulk actions on many findings or PRs at once (e.g., bulk dismiss, bulk apply fixes, batch re-review), an API for batch operations (OpenAPI probe returned 404), and hands-on corroboration.
